supporting_observations.claim: Before the reported RDP time, DC-RB-01 recorded service-ticket requests for FILE-RB-01$ from the WS-DSHARMA-01$ machine account. These records do not establish that dev.sharma initiated the alerted RDP session.

FILE-RB-01 had a WmiPrvSE.exe process running as SYSTEM at 13:28:26 UTC, before the reported RDP time; the available record does not identify a remote user or connect this process to the alerted session.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied collection-status metadata reports a log-collection outage from 13:30 to 14:15 UTC for winsec, Sysmon, and Zeek connection, DNS, and SSL telemetry on FILE-RB-01, WS-DSHARMA-01, WS-CPRICE-01, and DC-RB-01. This covers the reported RDP time.
Proxy telemetry is reported as available, but the provided records do not identify an RDP session or establish its source, authentication, or actions.
claims_not_established: Whether the reported RDP session occurred as described, and its source host, source address, and session logon ID.
Whether dev.sharma authenticated to FILE-RB-01 during the session or whether the account was used by another person.
Whether the session originated from WS-DSHARMA-01, as required by the stated IT practice, or from another host.
What actions, if any, were performed during the session and whether they were authorized by a ticket or change.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover FILE-RB-01 Security and TerminalServices RDP logs for 13:30–14:15 UTC, including logon type 10 events, source address, account, session ID, and logoff.
Recover corresponding domain-controller authentication and Kerberos records, and correlate them with the RDP session and source host.
Obtain endpoint authentication and process telemetry from WS-DSHARMA-01 and any identified source host for the same interval.
Check the relevant change calendar entries, tickets, and Remote Desktop Users membership as of the session time.
unrelated_findings: At 13:29:50–13:29:52 UTC, dev.sharma launched OpenSSH ssh.exe from WS-DSHARMA-01 to PROXY-RB-01. This is separate from the alerted RDP activity and merits review against approved-use policy. (S21-00093, S21-00094, S21-00095, S21-00096)
At 13:27:43 UTC, WS-DSHARMA-01 accessed slack.com through the proxy; Slack is not among the listed approved software or services. This does not determine the RDP alert. (S21-00081, S21-00082)
At 13:53 UTC, FILE-RB-01 made a proxy CONNECT to www.bing.com with a Go-http-client user agent. The provided record does not attribute this traffic to the alerted session. (S21-00300)

At 14:19 UTC, FILE-RB-01 made a proxy CONNECT to config.zscaler.net with a Zscaler Client Connector user agent and received status 502; this is not evidence of the alerted RDP session. (S21-00496, S21-00497)
